Avoid  for wire haired puppies especially wire haired daschunds.  I recently took my 7-month-old wire-haired dachshund here for his first proper hand strip. I had provided clear written instructions in advance that only his back and sides were to be stripped, and that his face should not be touched. I mentioned this again at drop off.

Unfortunately, this was not followed. His face, including his whiskers, were stripped, over stripped in fact, which was not what I had agreed to. He was also kept for over 4 hours, which I felt was excessive for a puppy of this age and for a first grooming/stripping  experience.

After the appointment, he appeared very sore and uncomfortable, and it was clear the experience had been distressing for him.

In addition, the overall finish did not reflect the correct shape in any way for a wire-haired dachshund, which was disappointing given the breed-specific nature of hand stripping. He had no beard or eyebrows! He also had several bald patches where hair which was not ready had been stripped. His breeder has indicated it may take up to a year for his facial features to recover with a small risk they never do so. Very disappointing as he is the son of a crufts champion and had a very good coat.

The result was not what I expected, and I was particularly disappointed that my instructions were not adhered to.

To their credit, the salon did acknowledge it was their mistake and did provide a refund after I raised my concerns, which I appreciate.  I thought long and hard before writing this review as I don’t want to ruin anyone’s business but I have ultimately felt the need to warn people. I would not recommend for wire haired dogs or puppies and certainly not for show dogs.

They advised me to book her as a small dog and said that if it turned out differently, we could sort it out on the day. I really appreciated that they didn’t immediately try to charge me for a larger size.

When we arrived, the shop was quiet and calm. The gentleman who greeted us was very friendly and took the time to chat with me about my dog and exactly how I wanted her groomed. He was really gentle with her, which instantly put me at ease. It was also the fastest groom she’s ever had – she was ready in under an hour, which was fantastic. There was no long wait for a phone call or hours of her being stressed.

She looks absolutely lovely, it was great value for money, and the customer service was excellent. I’d definitely return and would happily recommend them to others.
